text:
incident-bot: 🔔 Alert: Elevated 5xx and 429 rates observed for /v1/generate in us-west-2 (p95 error rate > 6%). Paging oncall.
matt: ack — I'm on it. pulling up dashboards.
sara: on my way, will grab traces and log tail. @matt check routing table for recent changes?
dan: I see sudden spike of 429s from rl-service at 15:12 UTC, then 502s from api-gateway starting 15:13. looks like rate limiter started returning 429s, upstream queueing caused 502/504s.
alex: linking dashboards: https://grafana.internal/redwood/requests?panel=errors&env=prod&region=us-west-2
lee: logs (tail): ```
2024-10-02T15:12:05Z rl-service WARN quota_exceeded user:acct_abc limit:100/sec
2024-10-02T15:12:06Z router ERROR upstream_timeout id=xyz
2024-10-02T15:12:07Z api-gateway ERROR 502 response_time=12000
``` 
matt: confirmed — root cause appears to be a misapplied rate-limit policy from a recent rollout: quota bucket for standard tier set to 100r/s instead of 1000r/s in us-west-2. change deployed by infra rollout at 15:10.
sara: can we rollback the policy? Dan, can you find the release/commit? dan: rollback patch found: infra/rl-config commit b3f7d2 — pushed by rollout-bot. I can revert to previous config, but that will take ~2-3m to propagate.
oncall-rotation: if revert takes >5m, recommend temporary mitigation: 1) disable quota enforcement for affected bucket 2) enable immediate soft-fail fallback that returns 429->200 with degraded token for internal clients 3) route traffic to us-east as fallback.
alex: 429->200 fallback risky for some customers (could blow budget). prefer to increase bucket to 2000r/s for 10m and monitor. less blast radius.
support-lead: beginning customer impact triage — which customers affected? prod-marketplace and search-indexing show elevated failures on our end and are paging support.
lee: running quick query: top 10 clients by 429s => acct_prod_mkt, acct_search, acct_plg_3, small mobile clients. 40% of 5xxs correlate to 429s upstream.
matt: action plan: (A) dan revert rl-config to previous commit (B) matt temporarily raise standard-tier bucket to 2000r/s (C) set routing fallback to us-east for non-VPC traffic (D) support to notify top impacted customers with ETA ~15-20m.
dan: starting revert now: `infractl rollback rl-config b3f7d2 --env prod --region us-west-2` — running.
eng-infra-bot: Rollback job started (job id: rl-rollback-20241002-15-18). ETA 90s.
sara: tailing logs for 15:18 — still seeing 429s but trending down slightly.
matt: applying temporary bucket bump: `infractl patch rl-config --region us-west-2 --bucket standard --limit 2000` — applying now.
eng-infra-bot: Patch applied (id: rl-patch-20241002-15-19). Propagating config to all rl-service pods.
lee: monitoring — p95 error rate dropping from 6.2% -> 2.1% in last 3 minutes. 502s from gateway falling too.
oncall-rotation: start notifying on-call handoff in 30m if stable. we need timeline for full recovery.
support-lead: sent interim status to affected customers: "We're investigating elevated errors impacting generation endpoints in us-west-2. Engineers have applied mitigations; we'll share updates in 15 minutes." :email:
alex: run a quick smoke: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer ..." https://api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'` -> returns 200, ok sampling looks good.
dan: rollback completed — confirmed previous rl-config restored. job id rl-rollback-20241002-15-20 succeeded.
eng-infra-bot: All rl-service replicas now running config v1.42. Metrics should be consistent within 120s.
matt: letting system stabilize. watch for recurrence, especially as background traffic spikes could re-trigger 429->queue->502 chain.
sara: starting extended tracing to capture request flow for the window 15:10-15:25 and collecting sample traces for root-cause analysis.
lee: creating temporary dashboard panel to track rl-service rejection rate + api-gateway 5xx correlation.
support-lead: updating customers with new ETA: "Mitigations applied; error rates are improving. Expect normal service within 15-30 minutes. We will follow up with a post-incident summary."
oncall-rotation: handing incident to next oncall @matt in 25m. current oncall will remain as primary until then. if errors spike again, page immediately.
alex: noted we should add a safety guard in rollout pipeline to prevent rl-config diffs >50% change in any region without manual approval.
matt: agreed — will open an infra-ops ticket and block the rollout until feature gate and canary checks in place.
sara: quick note — logs show a handful of mobile clients with aggressive retry logic that amplified the bursts. we'll include client guidance in postmortem.
support-lead: recording affected customers for RCA: acct_prod_mkt (high), acct_search (med), acct_plg_3 (low). will follow up with targeted mitigation for acct_prod_mkt.
dan: metrics stabilized: p95 error rate now 0.6%, 429 rate back to baseline. closing immediate mitigation.
incident-bot: Incident update: status=mitigated, severity=high, duration=~18m. incident channel retained for postmortem notes.
matt: closing thread once postmortem ticket created. create a SEV-2 ticket with timeline and action items.
lee: created ticket SEV-2-20241002-rl-quota-cascade (link: https://issues.internal/SEV-2-20241002) with action items: rollout guard, canary config, better metrics, adjust retry guidance.
sara: will grab traces + sample logs for postmortem and assign owners.
support-lead: will send final customer communication after RCA. admins: :thumbsup:
oncall-rotation: handing over fully to @matt (next oncall). please update if anything reappears.
matt: thanks everyone — great fast work. we'll debrief in 48 hours and publish postmortem."
